Exact crop of the published Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side), PDF page 24: the slip of [[Faithful Service (V) (Errata 3)]] (official text as of 27 April 2013; PDF built February 2014). It prints errata version PC-E3 (“Deploy on table. If opponent is about to remove their last card from Life Force, you may first place all your troopers in Used Pile (last card must still be removed). Your troopers are armor = 4. Your unique (•) [Hoth], [Endor], and [Death Star II] non-pilot warriors of destiny > 1 are troopers. [Immune to Alter]”), word for word the text of [[Faithful Service (V)]].<ref>[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Master List (Light Side)]]. Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>
